column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
# A base of - means no red run was possible. Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
veldra's fmt: a check that fails with no name it can parse is a loud FAIL
veldra's fmt: a new file rustfmt rewrites is named, though git diff cannot see it
veldra's fmt: and the log it names holds what the check printed
veldra's fmt: edited files rustfmt would not touch are not named
veldra's fmt: only the files rustfmt names, once each, relative to the tree
veldra's gate, two failing at once: the runs overlapped
veldra's gate, two passing at once: the runs overlapped
